segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאָב גּוֹלֶה עַל יְדֵי הַבֵּן, וְהַבֵּן גּוֹלֶה עַל יְדֵי הָאָב. הַכֹּל גּוֹלִין עַל יְדֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְיִשְׂרָאֵל גּוֹלִין עַל יְדֵיהֶן, חוּץ מִגֵּר תּוֹשָׁב. וְגֵר תּוֹשָׁב אֵינוֹ גּוֹלֶה אֶלָּא עַל יְדֵי גֵּר תּוֹשָׁב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The father is exiled» to a city of refuge «due to» his unintentional murder of his «son. And the son is exiled due to» his unintentional murder of his «father. Everyone is exiled due to» their unintentional murder of «a Jew, and a Jew is exiled due to» his unintentional murder of any of «them, except for» the unintentional murder of «a gentile who resides in Eretz Yisrael and observes the seven Noahide mitzvot [ger toshav]. And a ger toshav is exiled only due to» his unintentional murder of «a ger toshav.»

moves.summary: who is exiled on account of whom

positions.claim: father and son are exiled for each other; a ger toshav is exiled only for a ger toshav
